common.loadError: Something went wrong loading this section.
common.amountInvalid: Enter a USDC amount greater than zero with up to 6 decimal places.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Live status of your connected instance.

verifiedWallets.title: Verified wallets
verifiedWallets.description: Verify a custody wallet against this instance to unlock transactions. Verifying signs a challenge with the wallet; revoking removes it.
verifiedWallets.loadError: Couldn't load your wallets. Refresh the page to try again.
verifiedWallets.noWallets: No wallets found for user, create one.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Logical channels group activity within your connected instance. The default channel is created automatically and cannot be deleted.
channels.deleteDefaultTitle: The default channel cannot be deleted

members.title: Members
members.description: Invite SDP project users to your Private Channels workspace and manage which channels they belong to.
members.empty: No members yet. Invite an SDP project user to get started.
members.roleRevokedTooltip: Project membership revoked — remove this member
members.inviteDescription: Pick an SDP project user to invite. An SPC credential will be created for them.
members.removeDescription: Removes {email} from the workspace and all channels they belong to. Their SPC credential is retained (SPC has no delete-user endpoint) but is orphaned from SDP.

deposit.title: Deposit
deposit.description: Move USDC from a custody wallet into the channel escrow on devnet. Watch it progress from the escrow contract to an on-chain confirmation.
deposit.fromWalletHelp: The deposit is signed from this wallet. It must hold devnet USDC (and a little SOL).
deposit.recipientHelp: A wallet address or walletId to credit in the channel. Leave blank to credit this wallet.
deposit.stageSentDescription: Broadcasting the deposit to the escrow program on devnet.
deposit.noWalletsBefore: No verified wallets yet. Verify a custody wallet on the
deposit.noWalletsAfter: and fund it with devnet USDC, then come back to deposit.
deposit.selectWallet: Select a wallet to deposit from.

withdraw.title: Withdraw
withdraw.description: Burn a custody wallet's channel balance and have the operator release the matching USDC on devnet. Watch it progress from the burn to the devnet release.
withdraw.fromWalletHelp: The burn is signed from this wallet. Its channel balance is debited.
withdraw.destinationHelp: A devnet address or walletId to receive the released USDC. Leave blank to release to this wallet.
withdraw.stageBurnSentDescription: Broadcasting the burn to the channel chain.
withdraw.stageBurnConfirmedDescription: The burn confirmed and your channel balance was debited.
withdraw.stageReleasedDescription: The operator released the matching USDC to the destination.
withdraw.noWalletsBefore: No verified wallets yet. Verify a custody wallet on the
withdraw.noWalletsAfter: and deposit into the channel, then come back to withdraw.
withdraw.selectWallet: Select a wallet to withdraw from.

transfer.title: Transfer
transfer.description: Transfer USDC from your selected verified custody wallet to another verified member wallet in the same logical channel. Balances belong to the wallet and are shared across logical channels.
transfer.noChannels: You are not a member of any active private channel. Ask a channel administrator to add you before making a transfer.
transfer.noSourceWallets: You have no verified custody wallet that SDP can sign with. Verify a provisioned wallet under Overview before making a transfer.
transfer.fromWalletHelp: The transfer is signed from this wallet. Its channel balance is debited.
transfer.recipientsLoadFailed: Verified recipient wallets could not be loaded.
transfer.recipientsEmpty: No other channel member has a verified wallet eligible to receive this transfer.
transfer.selectChannelForRecipients: Select a channel to load verified recipients.
transfer.submitFailed: The transfer could not be submitted. Retry with the same details.
transfer.stageConfirmedDescription: SPC executed the transfer and the recipient's balance is updated. This is final.
transfer.stageSubmittedDescription: SPC accepted the transfer but has not reported the result yet. Check the recipient's balance before retrying, so you do not send twice.
transfer.stagePendingDescription: The transfer was recorded but its outcome was never written back. Check the recipient's balance before retrying.
transfer.stageFailedDescription: SPC did not complete the transfer, so no funds moved. You can try again.

events.title: Events
events.description: Project activity for Private Channels, including lifecycle, member, transfer, and error events. History is kept even after an instance is disconnected or deleted.
events.empty: No events yet. Connect an instance or create a channel to start the activity feed.

instance.title: Connect Private Channel
instance.description: Point SDP at a Solana Private Channels instance.
instance.disconnectSuccess: Private channel disconnected. You can edit and reconnect.
instance.reactivateDescription: This gateway URL has been connected to this project before. Reactivating will overwrite the stored config on the existing instance record. Any downstream data associated with it will now belong to the new configuration. Continue at your own risk.
instance.deleteDescription: This will permanently delete the instance record and all downstream data bound to it (channels, deposits, transfers). This cannot be undone.
